description: Piconit Metastasis Level (PML) is a Universal Index of piconit metastasis, not a professional rank.

hitpoints.baseFormula: 10 + REF DM + POW DM + PRE DM + MOV DM

minimumAgeRule: Minimum Age Rank = floor(PML / 4), with PML 1–3 treated as Age Rank 0.
notes: The Adventuring Rules PML Adjustments table is a quick reference for cumulative gains from the default PML 1 starting baseline; do not interpret its PML-1 dashes as zero total Favor or zero PML contribution to Hitpoints.
Where the quick-reference table conflicts with explicit formulas, the generator uses the explicit current rules text.
source: Book II — DXD Core Rules; Book III — Character Creation; Book VII — Adventuring Rules
